description: This file defines a React component named Insights that displays team persona and team statistics, including UI structure, styling, and related data types. It also contains a helper component StatBlock for rendering individual statistic blocks.

methods.name: Insights
methods.description: React functional component that displays team persona and stats information within styled Card components. It takes persona and teamStats props and renders various UI elements including headers, conditionally rendered data, and lists.

methods.name: StatBlock
methods.description: A helper React component that renders a styled display block showing a label and a value, with optional accent styling.
